items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance stuff should be carry the
 suitable safety category,

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area

Wear your safety helmet, shoes, 
 and gloves pairs.
Unit out of service.
Fire fighting system should be isolated.
Fuel system should be isolated.
Oil system should be isolated.
All switches in motor control center panel should be isolated.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Air power compact wrench inch.

Strong beam 
 light.

Combustion chamber accessories and pipes 
 removal

Remove the atomizing airlines from the fuel 
 nozzle.
Remove the fuel lines from the fuel nozzle.
Disconnect the spark plug leads.
Disconnect the flame detector.

Unlock and remove all fuel nozzles take in 
 consideration to mark the nozzles with its proper chamber number.

Mark each cover with the relative chamber 
 number.
Unbolt and remove the combustion covers.

Remove the 
 combustion liner no 1 as described below: 
 a- Remove the crossfire 
 tube clamps from chamber No 1. 
 b- Remove the crossfire tube clamps from adjacent chamber No. 
 2 and No. 10.
 c- Push the crossfire tube into adjacent chambers No 2 & No 
 10.
 d- Remove the liner No 1.
 e- Remove the crossfire tube with the adjacent chamber No. 2 
 & No. 10.

Repeat steps (a) to (e) to remove other 
 liners.

Inspect the crossfire tubes & retainers for 
 (wear, cracks& overheating) and record the results in the attached record 
 sheet

Inspect and maintain the fuel nozzle according 
 to the appropriate procedure and record the results in the attached sheet

Inspect the cap and liner if it should be 
 reused, repaired or scraped according to the criteria and record the results 
 in the attached sheet

Inspect the transition pieces with strong beam of light and records should be 
 made of any visible cracks, deposits or erosion and record the results in 
 the attached sheet

Clean all mating flange faces of any gasket 
 material.

Clean all hardware bolts & nuts with 
 wire-brush to remove traces of anti-seize or rust.

Lock maintained fuel nozzle with steel lock 
 wire.

Assemble liner No. 5 to the chamber. Slide the 
 crossfire tubes from chamber No. 6 & No. 4 into Liner No. 5.
Assemble liner No. 4.

Slide crossfire tube from liner No. 5 into 
 position between liners No. 4 & No. 5 and lock it with retainers.

Follow the a/m procedure for the remaining 
 chambers.

Energize the ignition transformers and 
 observes that the spark plugs are properly.

Check the flame detector works properly by 
 expose the scanner to suitable light.

Assembly the spark plugs and the flam 
 detector.

Assemble the combustion covers take in 
 consideration that the two larger bolts in the flanges are to be mated with 
 the holes in the cover and casing.

Reassemble the fuel nozzles but do not tighten 
 bolts firmly.

Reassemble the fuel piping and when mating 
 with the nozzle flanges. Tight the nozzle bolts firmly.

Operate the unit & take complete operating 
 reading set during operation Check the gas lines flange for leakage with soapy 
 solution.

sections.text: Preparation the unit for start after inspection

items:
Revise & check the clearness & cleanness of 
 working site.

Check the availability of DC & AC power 
 supplies.

Check batteries voltage should not be less 
 than 105 V.

Check the lube oil level and the fuel oil tank 
 of starting diesel engine.

Check the level of main tank lube oil in 
 normal level.

Operate the emergency lube oil pump check 
 direction of rotation and the discharge Pressure.

Check lube oil flow through sight glass at 
 bearing No.. (1, 2, 3).
Check the level of cooling water tanks.

Check valves position of fuel supply system in 
 operation position.
Check the position of cooling air dampers.

Check readiness of unit (No trip signal is 
 initiated) and the ready light signal is on.

Operate the unit at different speeds (200 
 rpm, crank speed, fire position, full speed no load) 
 ** 
 check the unit for:
 - 
 Leakage of fuel gas line (test with soapy solution).
 - Leakage of cooling and seal air pipes.
 - Abnormal noise or excessive vibration.

Operate the unit at (different loads 0%, 25%, 
 50%, 100%). Take complete operation reading and record the results in the 
 attached sheet
